milestones.title: Untagged and Rejected
milestones.when: cloud: a request refused for a missing required tag (policy `Require tag`, reported by cloud-api)

milestones.title: Wrong Neighbourhood
milestones.when: cloud: a request refused for a region outside `canadacentral`/`canadaeast` (policy `Allowed locations`)

milestones.title: Too Big to Ship
milestones.when: cloud: a request refused for a container size over the limit (`InvalidResourceRequest`)
